item.title: Are you sure it’s all (Classical) Greek to you?
item.description: Classical Greek level A is here to help! Together we will learn to uncover the roots of numerous words in various languages, gain insight into the etymology of words, begin to understand scientific terminology across fields like medicine, history, math, physics, and so much more.

item.title: Λόγος: From Logic to… Logo
item.description: "Logos" (λόγος) in the Ancient Greek language has various meanings; word or speech, the expression of thoughts and ideas. It is also used to convey reason or rationality, signifying the capacity for logical thought. In philosophical contexts, especially in the works of Heraclitus, "logos" can refer to a principle of order and knowledge governing the universe, reflecting the underlying structure or reason that brings coherence to the world.
